title: MAC Address Learning and ARP Operation
summary: Examine how Layer 2 switches build their MAC address table dynamically from incoming frame source MACs, and how Layer 3 hosts map IPv4 addresses to MAC addresses using ARP.
learning_objectives: Explain how a Cisco Catalyst switch dynamically populates its MAC address table using incoming frame source MAC addresses.
Demonstrate how switches forward frames using unknown unicast flooding versus known unicast filtering and forwarding.
Inspect host ARP cache tables (arp -a) and explain the ARP request and reply exchange.
Analyze the interaction between Layer 2 MAC address learning and Layer 3 ARP resolution during ping tests.
Observe dynamic MAC table aging and manual table clearance using clear mac address-table dynamic.
